description:
Built-in tool that the worker can call to spawn a subagent (ARCH §2.5, §3.3). One of the two new tools that v0.4's success criterion turns on.

Wire shape:
- Tool name: dispatch
- Input schema (input.json): { role: string (required), goal: string (required) }. role must resolve to <conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md and be present in the per-repo providers.yaml roles: block. Schema lands at <harness-root>/tools/dispatch.json.
- Skill: <harness-root>/skills/dispatch/SKILL.md. Frontmatter description becomes the tools[].description on the model call.
- Stdout (tool_result.content): JSON object {status: 'in_progress', handle: '<sub-conv-id>'}. The handle is the subagent's full hyphenated-descent branch name; per PRINCIPLES.md single-source-of-truth, no sidecar map is created — git's ref database is authoritative.
- Exit 0 on successful spawn; non-zero on spawn failure (treated as is_error per §3.3).

Implementation:
- In-process built-in: lernie tool dispatch. Reads tool_use.input from stdin. Spawns the subagent via Phase 1's lernie dispatch worker subcommand (so it goes through §3.4's CLI control plane, not a private function call). Returns immediately — does NOT wait for the subagent to finish.
- Tool-call commit lands on the parent branch per §3.3: input.json + output.json under steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/tools/<tool-id>/.
- Subagent branches off the commit where the tool-call landed (§2.5). Concretely: the dispatch tool runs after step N's tool_use commit lands; the subagent's spawn (Phase 1 lernie dispatch worker) takes that commit's sha as the branch-off point.

Out of scope:
- await (Phase 3).
- Wiring the dispatch tool into the default worker tools list (Phase 7).
- Recursive/parallel testing (Phase 5).

Tests:
- Stdio contract: input parses, schema validates, output JSON-shape matches.
- Spawn happens (subagent branch + worktree present after the tool returns).
- Tool returns synchronously (does not block on subagent completion).
- Failure paths: missing role in providers.yaml, missing soul file.

Done-when: a step that emits tool_use {name: dispatch, input: {role: 'worker', goal: '...'}} produces a per-call commit on the parent branch, a subagent branch + sibling worktree exist, and the tool_result returned to the agent on the next step is {status: in_progress, handle: '<sub-conv-id>'}.
title: v0.4 Phase 2: built-in tool — dispatch
